verdict.rationale: Omnara supports launching agents programmatically via dashboard, CLI, API, or SDK (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-14), and agents can spawn subagent helpers to parallelize work within a task (omnara-docs-19), plus org/project role management for multiple users/agents (omnara-gh-1). This implies concurrent agent operation is architecturally supported, but there is no explicit documentation of running many agents simultaneously, no concurrency limits/benchmarks, and no case study of scaled throughput. Missing for 10: explicit multi-agent concurrency documentation, throughput/scale benchmarks, and independent confirmation of running many agents at once.
